description: This file implements hash table rehashing and key management functions for Redis, including hash functions, comparison, display, stress testing, and main execution logic.

methods.name: _redisAssert
methods.description: Prints an assertion message and exits the program.

methods.name: dictKeyHash
methods.description: Computes a hash value for a given key using Redis's hash function and bitwise operations.

methods.name: showBuckets
methods.description: Displays the contents of a hash table bucket array.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the state of a hash table, including rehash index and buckets.

methods.name: sortPointers
methods.description: Comparison function for sorting dictEntry pointers based on their memory addresses.

methods.name: stressGetKeys
methods.description: Performs stress testing by requesting random keys from the dictionary and checking for correctness and duplicates.
